extension.name: eic_fp_action_provider
extension.description: Provides reusable CiviCRM Form-Processor action-provider conditions (e.g. CompareParameters) that other EIC extensions can use.

compatibility.comments: Semantic versioning. For example, compatibility with "6.1" implies compatibility with "6.2".

php_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "8.1" and "8.2".

smarty_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "4" and "5".

extension.comments: Provides the CompareParameters form-processor condition, registered via hook_civicrm_container. Must be enabled before the container rebuild that precedes the eic_eu_survey_form_processor import.
